rules.title: Feature modules
rules.text: Organize code into feature modules with explicit providers and exports.

rules.title: DTOs with validation
rules.text: Define DTO classes with class-validator and enable the global ValidationPipe with whitelist.

rules.title: Constructor injection
rules.text: Use constructor injection and avoid manually instantiating providers.

rules.title: Guards for authorization
rules.text: Enforce authentication and authorization with guards, not inside controllers.

rules.title: Exception filters
rules.text: Map domain errors to HTTP responses with exception filters.
